knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A single direction of travel prevents skipped and repeated areas. It is a method, not a client preference.
Food in a bin means the liner is replaced. Leaving food for a later visit is not acceptable.
Touch points get their own cloth so that residue from desks or toilets does not move onto them.

practicalCriteria: Works one route in a single direction without skipping or repeating a row.
At each desk, empties the bin, checks and replaces the liner when needed, and wipes the desk top with a clean cloth.
Sanitises touch points with a dedicated cloth and does not reach into a bin without looking.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% pass mark, which for three questions means all three correct. Practical sign-off is separate and observed by an assessor.
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of one full route
stopWorkCriteria: A cloth used on a toilet or restroom surface is used on a desk or touch point
A worker reaches into a bin without looking or presses waste down by hand
